thread:
Nora Patel: quick question about the new pipeline form: multiple collapsed sections + a dozen optional fields. Should we rely on inline errors or add an error summary to help people find hidden errors?

Marcus Li: add a compact summary only after submit fails. Inline is great for context but hidden errors kill discoverability.

Gina Torres: make summary items buttons that expand the relevant section and focus the field. Also include sr-only heading 'Form errors'.

Rob Flynn: required-marker: use visible '*' + sr-only 'required'. For collapsed headers show a small badge '1 required' so users know there are missing fields in a section.

Nora Patel: accessibility notes?

a11y-checker: suggest aria-live on summary (assertive) and ensure each input's aria-describedby points to the error text. Also cap summary list for very long forms and show 'and N more'. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/9999

Nora Patel: action items: Marcus prototype jump-to-error; Gina write copy for summary; Rob add badge to headers. Thanks!
